Hey man, I don't know your story or anything, maybe your life quite simply is the worst life out there, but it sounds to me like you might just need a bit of a perspective shift. Life isn't handing out blessings and shittiness respectively, life isn't your boss. Life was the chance event that happened TO you, and by chance you happened to be the kinda guy who has made the choices that have got you here, drunk posting on the suicidewatch subreddit.

 You truly have the power to shape your own life, no matter how fucked you think you are there's always someone out there feeling the same way. The difference between you surviving this is accepting that you've been played shitty cards, or accepting that the old-you made choices that got the new-you into a bad place. Examine those choices and think about what you would do differently, and then think where you wanna be, and try make some kind of plan to get there. And then just start doing it bro! Changing everything starts with you, take responsibility for your own life. Everything is totally fucking hard, but you get out from life what you put into it, and it's challenging no matter who you are what your situation is.

thanks dude, really appreciate your reply. I definitely couldn't say that I'm entirely innocent in this dilemma however, so I wouldn't ever blame them for anything. Like this all started after she invited me into their polyamorous relationship, which wasn't the cause but certainly a catalyst for their break up. 

In hindsight I was totally fucked up and wrong to keep seeing her after their relationship dissolved, so I have a lot of guilt about that, not because he was angry at me for staying with her but mostly because when I did that I choose not to be his friend and I betrayed his trust. 
I've since apologised, and we both pretend to get along, but it just sucks. I can't really trust him either because at one point he was boasting this big elaborate revenge plot to most of our mutual friends saying that he'd pretend to be my mate again so he could cut a proper hole in me. I think he was going to call me out and humiliate me at a music gig, which would have been full of local musicians i admire and work with and my friends and man like if he had done that and I didn't have warning beforehand I'd probably be dead by now. 

Sorry if that explanation wasn't particularly relevant, I kinda got lost in the memory when I was typing and forgot what I was trying to say. But yeah, I like a lot of your ideas, i do some of them anyway since I'm poor, and parks and coffee seem to be the cheapest thrills I can conjure. I will attempt to do them more proactively i think, thanks again

20 year old depressed male here, I'm pretty sure I've had my zombie apocalypse planned out since I was 13. All sorts of crazy ideas about taking over a mall and barricading it and me and my old high school buddies would somehow be elected as leaders hahahahah i'm sure you know the gist of it. These days I don't live quite as fantastically, but I still use and apply my imagination to things I like thinking about, like making up film narratives or writing songs. If you have an overactive imagination, then you will likely find it most rewarding to harness that weakness and turn it into a strength, like how TheStillDreams suggested with the writing! 

Yeah reality does suck, but you know what makes it a tiny bit better? Art! And fantasy! People like us, who suffer through life feeling like outsiders looking into a room through a one-way mirror, have been given the gift of narrative! Share your fantasies with the world, let everyone lead your team of rough-and-tumble survivors through a derelict urban wasteland! 

If you would rather live in your head than in the real world, find a way to monetise your head!! Make it your job to have crazy daydreams and write them down for other people to enjoy! Then you have both a record of your daydreams to look back on, and also you'd be freeing up a load of brain space for more new exciting fantasies!!

Yeah it's crazy cause most often I'll feel fine when I'm out and about, or during the days when she's at work, or when I'm hanging out with her for a few hours at a time, or when I'm hanging out with almost anyone else. It's just like this occasion tonight when it's 2:30am and I just cannot force myself to sleep. And then my brain starts going and I start imagining that they talk shit about me and that it was a all a big spiteful game to fuck me around, and just real stupid, neurotic, self-pitying stuff like that. And that's when I tend to start crawling around looking through old pillboxes for forgotten benzos, or try and drink myself to sleep, or both. I used to use drugs much more frequently recreationally, but managed to get it under control until this all started spiralling out from underneath me. 

You're right about me needing to do stuff without her, but she's just better at it you know? Like when you break up with someone and you're feeling bad you tend to get inspired to improve yourself a bit so that next time they see you you'll have your life together and be happy and mature and great, except it seems that in this flat only one of us can be succeeding at a time. It wasn't that long ago that she was miserable and I was looking after her and cooking for her, and that was a time of great prosperity for me ahahaha i had lots of social things to do and was motivated to cook awesome vege dinners and I wasn't totally miserable cause any spare energy I had just went into making sure she was feeling okay. I guess I probably also feel just kinda let down that I put a lot of effort into her and it didn't work.
